messages:
Samir K: Heads up — Nina from LumenTech reached out about lab access and the NDA before we kick off the perf/W + throughput sweep. They want a small dry-run first and confirmation of our telemetry schema and delivery method. Can ops/eng-ml weigh in?

Jess P: Quick Q for legal: do we need a full company NDA or is an MSA + benchmarking addendum fine for this scope? I think addendum is preferred so platform IP stays protected. @legal

Oliver M: From runtime side — we'll need to know whether partner will run our instrumented binary or their build. If they run theirs we'll need a kernel commit hash and exact env so results are comparable. We can provide a container image if that helps.

Li Chen: Telemetry schema proposal — minimal, non-PII. CSV columns: timestamp, run_id, model, quant_variant, seq_len, tokens, batch_size, avg_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms, throughput_tokens_s, power_w, gpu_temp_c, kernel_commit, notes. Sample header CSV: "timestamp,run_id,model,quant_variant,seq_len,batch_size,tokens,avg_latency_ms,p95_latency_ms,p99_latency_ms,throughput_tokens_s,power_w,gpu_temp_c,kernel_commit,notes"

Nina (LumenTech): S3 presigned uploads are fine for us. TTL 48h ok. We'll need a checklist for lab access (ssh key format, allowed IPs). Also can we get a short script that validates telemetry headers?

BenchBot: Scheduled: dry-run -> 2024-12-12 14:00 PT, run_id=redwood-dry1. Created job ticket #RB-4456.

Jess P: :thumbsup: I'll draft the benchmarking addendum and loop legal. Expect draft by EOD tomorrow.

Oliver M: Minimal run command to share with partner:
```
./run_bench --model=gpt-3.5x --batch=8 --seq=1024 --tokens-per-iter=512 --telemetry=out/telemetry_redwood-dry1.csv 
# env: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0, kernel_commit=abc1234short
```

Li Chen: Two notes: 1) kernel_commit should be the short git sha (7-10 chars). If partner can't provide, mark kernel_commit=unknown. 2) Add field quant_variant (eg q8_0, q4_1) so we can group runs.

Nina (LumenTech): We can run the container you provide and will return telemetry.csv in the agreed format. Regarding kernel tuning: we prefer not to change GPU clocks in our lab. If you need a kernel patch, can it be applied on a canary node only?

Samir K: Proposed plan: 1) sign addendum, 2) exchange S3 presigned + onboarding form, 3) dry-run on canary node Dec 12, 14:00 PT, 4) one optional kernel patch applied only to canary if needed, 5) share aggregated metrics and flamegraphs under NDA. Dashboard link: https://redwood.example.com/runs/redwood-dry1 (internal)

Jess P: Any objections to sharing flamegraph profiles (aggregated) under NDA? I want to avoid sharing raw traces out of their bucket.

Oliver M: No objections. Raw traces stay in partner-controlled bucket. Redwood gets aggregated metrics and the flamegraph svg/png exports only. Keeps us safe and gives enough signal for kernel tuning.

BenchBot: Reminder: ticket RB-4456 assigned to @Li Chen and @Oliver M. Next reminder in 48h.

Nina (LumenTech): Sounds good. I'll reply with the onboarding form and a list of allowed IPs by EOD. Thanks everyone — excited to get this started :party_popper:

Samir K: Great — thanks team. I'll coordinate the addendum thread with legal and ping once it's signed.
